name: Formula 1
description: Live F1 timing, next race countdown, and driver/constructor championship standings. No API key required.
author: James Steward

board.title: Board Size
board.description: Which display the pre-built lines are formatted for.

display_mode.title: Display Mode
display_mode.description: What the pre-built lines show. 'auto' switches to live timing during a session, otherwise falls back to the mode below.

fallback_mode.title: Fallback Mode (auto only)
fallback_mode.description: What 'auto' shows when no session is live. If a session is running but timing data is unavailable, the standings are shown instead of a countdown to a distant session.

countdown_step_minutes.title: Countdown Step (minutes)
countdown_step_minutes.description: How coarsely the countdown is rounded below 24 hours. 15 means the board changes four times an hour. Set to 1 for a minute-by-minute countdown (much noisier).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Timezone used for session start times and countdowns.

include_practice.title: Include Practice Sessions
include_practice.description: Treat free practice sessions as live/upcoming. Turn off to only track Qualifying, Sprint and Race.

live_window_minutes.title: Live Window (minutes)
live_window_minutes.description: How many minutes before a session starts and after it ends to keep showing live timing.

live_refresh_seconds.title: Live Refresh (seconds)
live_refresh_seconds.description: How often to poll OpenF1 while a session is live. Lower values are more responsive but hit the API harder.

standings_refresh_seconds.title: Standings Refresh (seconds)
standings_refresh_seconds.description: How often to refresh championship standings from Jolpica.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often FiestaBoard asks this plugin for data. Live data is cached separately at the interval above.

env_vars.name: F1_TIMEZONE
env_vars.description: Timezone override (can also be set in the web UI).

status.description: Session state: LIVE while running, SOON just before or after, OFF otherwise

session_name.description: Full session name from the timing feed

session_short.description: Abbreviated session name that fits a Note

session_type.description: Session category: Practice, Qualifying or Race

circuit.description: Short circuit name for the live session

country.description: Three-letter country code for the live session

gp_name.description: Grand Prix name for the live session

flag.description: Current track-wide flag or safety car state

track_status.description: Alias of flag, for readability in templates

lap.description: Lap counter, with the total where the race distance is known

lap_total.description: Scheduled race distance in laps; blank if not known

leader.description: Three-letter code of the driver currently leading

leader_name.description: Surname of the driver currently leading

leader_team.description: Team of the driver currently leading

p1.description: Driver code currently in first place

p2.description: Driver code currently in second place

p3.description: Driver code currently in third place

gap_p2.description: Second place's gap to the leader

gap_p3.description: Third place's gap to the leader

next_gp.description: Grand Prix name of the next session

next_country.description: Country code of the next session

next_session.description: Which session is next: FP1, QUALI, SPRINT, RACE

next_local_date.description: Date of the next session in your timezone, as weekday and DD/MM

next_local_time.description: Start time of the next session in your timezone, 24-hour

countdown.description: Time until the next session. Days above 24h, otherwise hours and minutes rounded down to the countdown step; SOON inside the final step.

countdown_days.description: Whole days until the next session

countdown_minutes.description: Exact minutes component, unrounded (use countdown for a board-friendly value)

season.description: Championship season the standings are drawn from

round.description: Round number the standings are current to

wdc_points.description: Points held by the championship leader

wdc_gap.description: Championship leader's advantage over second place

wcc_points.description: Points held by the leading constructor

wcc_gap.description: Leading constructor's advantage over second place

mode.description: Which layout the pre-built lines are currently rendering

line1.description: Pre-built board row 1, laid out for your configured board size (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line2.description: Pre-built board row 2 (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line3.description: Pre-built board row 3 (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line4.description: Pre-built board row 4 (Flagship only; blank on a Note) (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line5.description: Pre-built board row 5 (Flagship only; blank on a Note) (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line6.description: Pre-built board row 6 (Flagship only; blank on a Note) (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

updated.description: Local time this data was last refreshed, 24-hour

screenshots.alt: Live F1 timing displayed on a Vestaboard Note
screenshots.caption: Live positions, gaps and lap count during a session - no API key required

screenshots.alt: Driver championship standings with team colour blocks on a Vestaboard Note
screenshots.caption: Championship standings, with each driver's team shown as a block of Vestaboard colour tiles
